Senior citizens from various groups and communities gather at a mall in Quezon City on Saturday, October 25, 2025, as they join the Seniors Kontra Kurakot Protest Walk, calling for transparency and accountability in government. 
 
Participants walk around the mall to symbolize the continuous fight against corruption, stressing that integrity and good governance must be upheld by every generation, at every stage of life. | via Maria Tan, ABS-CBN News
